description: No error detected in the reasoning.
instruction: Solve the smae way as before.

description: Input does not conform to expected format or type, such as a string where a number is required.
instruction: Validate all inputs before processing; ensure they match the expected data type and format.

description: Attempts to divide by zero, which is undefined.
instruction: Check denominators before division; if zero, handle with an error message or alternative logic.

description: Accesses an index or value outside the defined range of a list or array.
instruction: Verify all indices are within valid bounds before accessing elements; use checks or exceptions to handle out-of-bounds access.

description: Combines incompatible types, such as adding a string to a number.
instruction: Ensure all operations involve compatible types; convert types explicitly when necessary.

description: Contains invalid syntax that prevents execution, such as missing parentheses or incorrect operators.
instruction: Review code for proper syntax; use a linter or syntax checker to identify issues.

description: The logic of the solution is flawed, leading to incorrect results without syntax errors.
instruction: Trace through the logic step-by-step; use test cases to verify each logical step produces expected outcomes.

description: Generates a token that is not a valid numeral, forcing a fallback or sentinel value.
instruction: Verify that every numeric token parses as an actual number before using it in any equation.

description: Halts mid-process so no complete result is produced.
instruction: Ensure every solution path reaches a final computed result; flag and continue if an intermediate step ends prematurely.

description: Mismanipulates symbols when isolating or combining variables.
instruction: Check each symbolic move by substituting test values and confirming the transformed equation remains equivalent.

description: Performs a basic operation incorrectly, altering magnitude or sign.
instruction: Re-compute each elementary operation independently and cross-verify with an alternate method (e.g., reverse operation).

description: Adds an unstated premise that changes the setup or calculation.
instruction: List every premise explicitly and confirm each one is stated or logically inferred before proceeding.

description: Misinterprets a comparative phrase, building the wrong relation between variables.
instruction: Translate each comparison into an inequality or ratio, then rephrase it in plain language to confirm the intended relation.

description: Treats sequential percentage changes additively instead of multiplicatively (or vice versa).
instruction: Apply each percentage change to the current subtotal and note the running result after every step.

description: Reads a limiting condition incorrectly and omits or misapplies it.
instruction: Restate every condition in a checklist and tick each one off only after it has been encoded into the equation or logic.

description: Counts elements or cases incorrectly, giving a wrong subtotal.
instruction: Enumerate items with a tally or table, then recount using a different ordering to verify the subtotal matches.

description: Adds the same subtotal more than once, inflating the final result.
instruction: Mark each subtotal once it is added; decline any addition whose source set overlaps with an already-counted set.

description: Applies the same conversion or scaling factor twice.
instruction: Record every scaling factor in a log; before applying one, confirm it does not already appear in the log for the same value path.

description: Removes the same portion twice, producing an unduly small value.
instruction: After subtracting a portion, tag the corresponding elements as removed and prevent further subtraction on tagged elements.

description: Builds equations that do not reflect the stated relationships.
instruction: Translate the verbal statement into equations term-by-term, then paraphrase the equations back into words to verify fidelity.

description: Uses the reciprocal of a required ratio.
instruction: Cross-check ratios by writing them both ways (a : b and b : a) and choose the form that matches the stated direction of change.

description: Executes steps in the wrong sequence, so later operations act on an incorrect intermediate value.
instruction: Draft a numbered sequence of operations before computing, then follow the sequence exactly, adjusting only with explicit re-ordering notes.

description: Omits a stated requirement while solving.
instruction: Maintain a visible checklist of all stated requirements and confirm each item is reflected in the final equation or logic.

description: Fails to divide by a necessary count or rate when computing an average or per-unit value.
instruction: For every average or rate, write the general form “total ÷ count”; verify both numerator and denominator are present before simplification.

description: Does not adjust an intermediate subtotal after a stated change, so an outdated value persists.
instruction: Refresh every stored subtotal immediately after any change operation, and annotate the update in the working notes.

description: Ignores intersection between groups, leading to over- or under-count.
instruction: Identify intersections explicitly (e.g., with Venn logic) and adjust subtotals by adding or subtracting overlap exactly once.

description: Rounds too early or incorrectly, shifting the intermediate value enough to change the final result.
instruction: Defer rounding until the final step; if an interim display is needed, keep the unrounded value in memory and note the precision used.

description: Inserts the wrong variable or value into an equation.
instruction: Label each variable clearly and cross-reference the label before every substitution; perform a quick dimensional or sign check after substitution.

description: Swaps minuend and subtrahend or miscomputes the difference.
instruction: Rewrite each subtraction as an addition of the opposite sign and verify the sign of the result against an estimate.

description: Uses inconsistent units or forgets to convert before combining values.
instruction: Annotate every value with its unit symbol, convert all to a common system before operations, and verify units cancel or combine as expected.
